summary: Tested the free 3 km zone feature. Backend: 4/4 pytest pass. mer-1 returns free_zone {43.4516,-80.4925,km 3.0,per_km 1.25,from 'depot'}, mer-2 returns its pharmacy pickup (43.4201,-80.4405) with from 'pharmacy', there is a 401/403 without auth and a 404 for an unknown merchant. Frontend, logged in as admin at 390x844 and 375x667 with 4 temporary TEST_ pending stops (2 per store, inside and outside): the FREE DISTANCE ZONE section, free-zone-card, free-zone-map, map-zone ellipse, the HQ/RX origin marker, green/red numbered markers, the 'FIRST 3 KM BY ROAD INCLUDED · THEN CA$1.25/KM' title, the 'Measured from…' line and free-zone-count (with correct singular/plural and inside/outside counts) all render. The count line is hidden when there are no open orders (mer-2). The circle is never clipped (it stays inside the 32px padding). Green/red tones match the haversine check. FAIL 1: the circle is NOT round. With no far orders it is 311x156 px (2:1 oval) on both stores, and about 1.5:1 to 1.9:1 when an outside order is present. FAIL 2: the mer-1 HQ origin marker is fully hidden under an open order at the depot coordinates. Driver (/driver/drv-1), admin route (/admin/route/<id>) and customer (/customer/MD1001) maps still render with markers and polyline and no ellipse, with no console errors.

ui_bugs.issue: The zone circle is drawn as a stretched ellipse. proj() scales x by (size.w-2pad)/lngSpan and y by (size.h-2pad)/latSpan separately, so the aspect ratio is not kept. Measured: mer-1/mer-2 with only nearby orders give 311x156 px at 375w (rx 155, ry 78). With an outside order: mer-1 230x156, mer-2 231x124. Requirement 'roughly round' fails. Fix: use one px-per-km scale, s = min((w-2pad)/(lngSpan*111.32*cos(lat0)), (h-2pad)/(latSpan*111.32)), and centre the bounds in both axes. This also makes driver/admin maps geographically true.

The origin marker (HQ) is drawn first, so open orders drawn later cover it. On mer-1 a real pending order (43.45166,-80.49199) sits at the depot, and the HQ label is completely invisible in the screenshots. Fix: render the origin last or give it a higher zIndex. Optionally nudge/offset overlapping markers.

issues: The HUB marker and driver marker are at y≈415 inside a 397px-tall map, hidden behind the 'DRIVER IS 1 STOP AWAY' banner, so the map looks empty. With only 2 almost identical points the bounds put them in the corner. Consider bottom padding for the banner or centring when the span is tiny.

action_items: RouteMap.web.tsx: change proj() to an aspect-preserving (uniform km-per-px) projection centred in the box, so the zone ellipse renders as a circle (rx≈ry). Recheck at 390x844 and 375x667 so the circle is still not clipped.
Render the origin marker (HQ/RX) above order markers (render last / zIndex) so it is never hidden by an order at the same spot.
critical_code_review_comments: FreeZoneCard: kmBetween() duplicates haversine already used elsewhere; minor DRY issue.
FreeZoneCard: open orders are capped at 30 with slice(0,30), so free-zone-count only counts the first 30 open orders, not all of them. Consider labelling it or counting all.
Native RouteMap.tsx/android use real metre circles (zone.km*1000), so they stay round; only the web fallback is distorted.

rca_of_issue: The web schematic projection fits lat and lng spans into the box on separate axes. The zone's N/S/E/W edges set the bounds, so the circle always fills the full width (w-64) and full height (h-64) → ellipse ratio ≈ (w-64)/(h-64) ≈ 2:1 for a 375x220 map.
